    p = prev_contrib.shape[1]
    total = prev_contrib.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    share = np.where(total > 0, prev_contrib / np.maximum(total, 1e-12), 1.0 / p)
    return pool[:, None] * share

    w = (pool / cap)[:, None] ** 22
    return pool[:, None] * (w / p + (1 - w) * prop)

def allocate(pool, prev_offer, prev_contrib, t, mem, cap, growth):
    G, p = prev_offer.shape
    if t == 1:
        mem['rel'] = np.full((G, p), 0.6)
        mem['streak0'] = np.zeros((G, p))
        mem['trust'] = np.full((G,), 0.5)
        mem['prev_pool'] = np.array(pool, copy=True)

    safe_off = np.maximum(prev_offer, 1e-6)
    frac = np.clip(prev_contrib / safe_off, 0.0, 1.0)
    offered = prev_offer > 1e-9

    mem['rel'] = np.where(offered, 0.76 * mem['rel'] + 0.24 * frac, 0.965 * mem['rel'])
    rel = mem['rel']

    zero_now = offered & (prev_contrib < 1e-9)
    mem['streak0'] = np.where(zero_now, mem['streak0'] + 1, np.maximum(mem['streak0'] - 1, 0.0))
    chronic_penalty = 1.0 / (1.0 + 0.25 * mem['streak0'])

    tot_off = prev_offer.sum(axis=1)
    tot_ret = prev_contrib.sum(axis=1)
    pop_frac = np.where(tot_off > 1e-9, np.clip(tot_ret / np.maximum(tot_off, 1e-9), 0.0, 1.0), mem['trust'])
    mem['trust'] = 0.75 * mem['trust'] + 0.25 * pop_frac
    trust = mem['trust']

    fullness = np.clip(pool / cap, 0.0, 1.0)
    fcol = fullness[:, None]

    floor = np.clip(0.10 + 0.07 * fcol, 0.10, 0.17)
    score = floor + (1 - floor) * rel

    weights = 0.55 * score + 0.45 * (prev_contrib + 0.1 * p) / p
    weights = weights * chronic_penalty
    weights = np.maximum(weights, 0.035)

    skew = np.clip(1.75 - 0.9 * fcol, 0.85, 1.75)
    weights = weights ** skew

    wsum = weights.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    wsum = np.where(wsum <= 0, 1.0, wsum)
    weights = weights / wsum

    # pool trend: is the reservoir shrinking? if so be more cautious
    shrinking = np.clip((mem['prev_pool'] - pool) / np.maximum(mem['prev_pool'], 1e-6), 0.0, 1.0)
    mem['prev_pool'] = np.array(pool, copy=True)

    retain = np.clip(0.55 - 0.55 * trust, 0.0, 0.5) * (1 - 0.7 * fullness)
    retain = np.clip(retain + 0.3 * shrinking, 0.0, 0.65)
    weights = weights * (1 - retain[:, None])

    return weights
